name: brand-ai-readiness-audit
description: Audits any website for the reasons AI assistants fail to find, trust or cite a brand, and the reasons visitors who arrive do not stay. Emits one prioritized, evidence-backed report of findings and fixes. Recommend-only: read-only GET traffic, robots.txt honoured, no skill ever alters a live site.

skills.owns: Composes every other skill and emits the final report
Can a crawler reach the page and read it (also owns the shared evidence collector)
Is it clear who this is, and do markup and visible page agree
Is this the kind of page answer engines actually quote
Can real questions about the brand be answered from its own content
Is it current, self-consistent and independently corroborated
Does a visitor who arrives orient, act and reach their goal
Adjudicates every finding before it reaches the report
